writingPolicy.identity: Present Faris as a Software Engineer focused on backend systems, fullstack web development, production infrastructure, and applied AI as a supporting software capability.
writingPolicy.focus: Prioritize concrete engineering ownership, system behavior, architecture choices, production operations, and technologies supported by evidence. Prefer plain language over promotional adjectives.
avoid: Machine Learning Engineer or Data Scientist positioning
selecting or including DBS Foundation or any Machine Learning Engineer roles in the CV; focus exclusively on backend, fullstack, and cloud software engineering roles
generic filler such as passionate, hardworking, cutting-edge, innovative, robust, scalable, seamless, high-performance, results-driven
claims about impact, scale, quality, or outcomes that are not directly supported by evidence
AI-only identity that obscures core backend and software engineering work
keyword stuffing or repeating the same technology across multiple sections without context
formulaic project prose that repeats the same sentence structure
